CLM-DEV-0066.statement: Training the MLP surrogate model takes approximately 1 minute on a laptop with an Intel Core i5-13600H CPU using the MATLAB Deep Learning Toolbox.

extra_quotes: The surrogate model was trained on simulation data from a set of 4999 designs which were generated by varying epitaxial layer parameters and simulating each design with Harold to extract performance metrics.
Using the surrogate, rather than full device simulation, reduces computation time for a million designs from 231 days to∼2 minutes on a standard laptop.

With a data set of 4999 samples (3499 for training and 750 each for validation and test), the model demonstrates good performance with a coefficient of determination,R 2, greater than 0.91 for all 6 targets when trained on 3499 input samples and a meanR 2 of 0.94 averaged across the 6 targets.

In considering the limitations of our approach, it should be noted that the surrogate model demonstrated here is only valid for the epitaxial parameter space in Table I which has no variation in the active region, and a fixed laser geometry (600µmX 25µm).
We have not yet checked accuracy against real device measurements, however, we plan to make this comparison in future work.
